title: Cardinal Billing Account Renewal Down Payment: Reduction by Payment Method
content:
A payment-method reduction is subtracted from the renewal down payment percentage of a Cardinal Billing Account, set by the method of the most recent payment posted to the account.

| Method of the most recent payment posted to the account | Reduction |
|---|---|
| Bank EFT | 3 percentage points |
| Debit card | 1 percentage point |
| Credit card | 1 percentage point |
| Check, money order or cashier's check | None |

**Notes**

- The payment read is the latest payment entry on the account's billing history, by posting date, whatever channel it came through.
- The reduction is in percentage points of the percentage.

**Hypothetical figure.** A renewal down payment percentage of 30 percent on an account whose most recent payment was made by bank EFT becomes 27 percent; had that payment been made by money order it would stay 30 percent.
